Name: Seed Planner
Author: Bartpirat
Description:
[b][size=5]Seed Planner[/size][/b]
[i]Which seeds should I buy today?[/i] This mod answers that question in one keypress – using your actual save: today's date, farming level, professions, gold and shop prices.

[b]Languages:[/b] English · Deutsch · 한국어 (Korean by slpOff) · 中文 · Português · Español · Русский · Français · 日本語 · Italiano · Türkçe – switches automatically with your game language.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Seed ranking for today (F6)[/b] – every crop you can plant outside right now, sorted by total profit until the season ends. Shows harvests, profit per day, seed price and how many seeds you can afford.[/*]
[*][b]Best sequence until season end[/b] – combines crops to use the whole season (e.g. Parsnip on day 17, then Potato on day 21). The crop to plant today is marked with a green [i]plant today[/i] badge.[/*]
[*][b]Options in the window[/b] – sell raw or as keg/jar products (Artisan profession included), fertilizer (including speed-gro), special seeds (Strawberry, Ancient Fruit, ...).[/*]
[*][b]Greenhouse and Ginger Island[/b] – switch the location between farm, greenhouse and the island farm (once unlocked). There every crop grows all year, so you plan for the next 28 days or a whole year. Cactus fruit and other indoor-only crops only show up where they can be planted.[/*]
[*][b]Three plot modes[/b] – a fixed number of plots, as many as your gold can buy, or the [b]free tilled plots at the chosen location[/b] (limited by your gold too).[/*]
[*][b]Mini window (F7)[/b] – small, draggable overlay with today's top 3 and the sequence. Click it to open the full planner.[/*]
[*][b]Community Center hints[/b] – items a bundle still needs get a small bundle icon in your inventory, chests, toolbar and shops (grey if the quality isn't good enough yet). Hover them for a green box with the bundles.[/*]
[*][b]Community Center overview (F8)[/b] – every open bundle grouped by room, with the missing items. [color=#6ab04c]Green[/color] = you have it in your inventory, [color=#4a90e2]blue[/color] = it's in a chest somewhere.[/*]
[/list]
The math includes crop quality by farming level and fertilizer, Tiller/Agriculturist/Artisan, regrowing and multi-season crops, extra harvest chances and giant crops.

[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Controls & config[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]F6[/b] – open/close the Seed Planner[/*]
[*][b]F7[/b] – toggle the mini window[/*]
[*][b]F8[/b] – Community Center overview[/*]
[*][b]No F keys?[/b] Click the little seed packet icon under the clock – it opens a menu with all three.[/*]
[/list]Change the keys in [i]config.json[/i] (created after the first launch): [i]ToggleKey[/i], [i]HudKey[/i], [i]BundleKey[/i] – controller buttons work too. Set [i]ShowButton[/i] to [i]false[/i] to hide the icon, [i]BundleHints[/i] to [i]false[/i] to hide the tooltip hints. Window options are saved per save file.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0+[/*]
[*]Made for single-player; multiplayer should work (each player uses their own gold and skills) but isn't tested yet[/*]
[*]Reads crops, prices and bundles from the game data, so crops added by other mods and remixed bundles should show up as well.[/*]
[*]Translations: English, German, Korean (thanks to [b]slpOff[/b]!), Chinese, Portuguese, Spanish, Russian, French, Japanese, Italian, Turkish. These eight are new – corrections from native speakers are very welcome! Other languages fall back to English ([i]i18n[/i] folder).[/*]

Downloads.Description: Requires SMAPI 4.0+ and Stardew Valley 1.6. Unzip into your Mods folder. F6 planner, F7 mini window, F8 Community Center overview – or click the seed icon left of your gold. Click a crop to exclude it. Optional: GMCM. 11 languages.

Manifest.Name: Seed Planner
Manifest.Description: Shows which seeds make the most money today and the best planting sequence until season end, plus Community Center helpers. Press F6.
